subject: MedSupply procurement onboarding — PO schema, MSA redlines, and Ariba registration
messages:
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@medsupply.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial checklist & PO format - Redwood onboarding

Hi Olga / Marcus,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Procurement is ready to move to vendor registration but we need two concrete things before our supplier portal team starts the push: 1) a redlined MSA we can send to Legal for quick review, and 2) a canonical PO schema (CSV or EDI mapping) so our Ariba team can validate the integration.

A few specifics from our side:
- We require PO acknowledgement with the PO number returned within 4 business hours or the PO goes to auto-reject.
- Invoices must include GL code and cost center strings in the third line for automated AP parsing.
- We prefer EDI 850/810 mapping but can accept flat CSV to a secure SFTP drop for the first 30 days.

Can you attach the most recent redline and a sample PO export? Also please confirm whether Redwood supports sending an invoice PDF via SFTP with a matching PO number in the filename.

Best,
Samantha Jones
Director, Strategic Sourcing
MedSupply Inc.

Samantha — thanks, this is clear and actionable. Quick answers up front: yes, we can support EDI 850/810 and a CSV SFTP ingest window. We also include PO acknowledgement headers in our Ariba connector by default.

I attached: 1) "Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.docx" (highlights: liability cap language and data processing addendum), and 2) "PO-EDI-mapping-spec.xlsx" (sample mapping and a flat CSV example).

Two internal notes for our side: Karthik, Marcus — legal asked us to push a targeted redline (only the liability and DPA bits) rather than a full MSA rewrite. Can you confirm we are comfortable requesting MedSupply limit MSA counterpoints to those sections or Legal will take full review if they add other terms?

Samantha — I'll follow up with the SFTP details and an example filename pattern we recommend (PO12345_INV.pdf).

Thanks,

Subject: Internal: legal scope on MedSupply MSA counter

Internal only — quick thread.

Legal's guidance: we should ask for focused edits only. Two asks we will push back on if MedSupply broadens the redline set: 1) keep liability cap at $2M (we can flex per ARR bands), and 2) include a standard Redwood DPA reference rather than bespoke clauses. If they expand to indemnity or data residence, escalate to Legal and CS for potential second-level review.

Marcus — can you prepare the short summary doc for Legal (one page) that calls out exactly which clauses we expect them to edit and the win-lose tradeoffs? I'll include that with our vendor request to keep turnaround sub-72 hours.

-Karthik
Principal Counsel, Redwood Inference

Samantha / team — coordinating next steps and confirming technical pieces.

1) PO schema: attached "PO-EDI-mapping-spec.xlsx" has the GL code column we will populate during order transmission. We'll include a short mapping table (PO.field -> MedSupply.GLCode) and an example CSV export (header order is significant).

2) SFTP rules: filename pattern: MEDSUP_PO_<PONUMBER>_<YYYYMMDD>.csv; checksum: SHA256 in sidecar .sha256 file with same base name. We'll provide an SFTP test account and a sample ingestion run once you complete the Ariba registration.

3) Ariba validation error: Marcus to own a one-off export transformation if MedSupply wants us to post-process to match their strict length rules — we can do that during the 30-day CSV SFTP pilot.

4) Legal: Karthik — I uploaded the one-page summary to the onboarding drive (link below). If Legal approves the focused redline, I'll coordinate a DocuSign envelope for the MSA + Order Form bundle.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/s/MedSupply-Onboarding-Checklist (onboarding checklist), https://docusign.com/envelopes/0A1B2C3D4E

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Wed to action the SFTP test and DocuSign flow.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Partner Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
